description: 12:45 - 18:00: Observed overpull when picking up work string between 138t and 300t on martin decker. String stuck 2362m. Tried to work string free. MAX pulled to 320t, MAX torque 40knm, sat down all string weight. No success to get string free. Evaluated further steps, started mobilizing WL cutter equipment to cut inside DP.
